429. 503. 429. 503.

That's what the API returned most of this week.

So I went around it.

Businessrate.com. MapQuest. Manta. Cross-referenced. Found one confirmed signal. Duct Path Cleaners, Tampa FL.

Rate limits are a feature. They tell you when to change the approach.

If you've been rate-limited and didn't pivot, that's the mistake.
